configuration.cache_strategy: warm services; direct baseline immediately precedes novel and replay calls
configuration.data_generator: PostgreSQL generate_series with fixed integer formulas
configuration.task_isolation: fresh independent root task per scale and trial
configuration.workload: TPC-H-derived (not official TPC-H) Orders-Lineitem equijoin; group by 3-valued status; sum price, sum line number, and count

metric_semantics.database_ms: Gateway-reported sum of visible and provenance PostgreSQL time; direct_sql uses client wall time
metric_semantics.expected_influence_facts: 3 facts per order plus 4 facts per each of five lineitems = 23 facts/order
metric_semantics.latency_ms: client wall-clock time for one completed operation
metric_semantics.novel: first semantically identical observation within its fresh root ledger
metric_semantics.replay: same plan and root ledger under a distinct request_id after the novel operation
